# Open Graph backgrounds

These seven Minecraft shader screenshots were supplied by the project owner on
2026-08-31:

- `forest-pond.jpg`
- `garden-cottage.jpg`
- `birch-lantern-path.jpg`
- `pond-bench.jpg`
- `cherry-grove.jpg`
- `flower-garden-path.jpg`
- `koi-pond.jpg`

At each frontend build, `scripts/generate-og-images.mjs` shuffles the set and
assigns one distinct background to each domain. It then adds the project logo
and Galmuri site name.
